cues.en: Well, first of all, the term higher order is a general term.
cues.zh: 首先，「高階」是一般性的稱呼。

cues.en: You already know how to compute the derivative, which is also called the first derivative, and then the second derivative is actually just the derivative of the derivative.
cues.zh: 你已經會算導數，也叫一階導數；二階導數，就是導數的導數。

cues.en: So to compute the second derivative, you start by computing the first derivative, and then you pretend
cues.zh: 所以計算二階導數，先求一階，再假裝

cues.en: So literally just the derivative of the derivative.
cues.zh: 真的就只是導數的導數。

cues.en: And then to compute the third derivative, you take the derivative of the derivative of the derivative and so on.

cues.en: Well, you can see the pattern here.

cues.en: The nth order derivative is just taking the derivative end times.
cues.zh: n 階導數，就是微分 n 次。

cues.en: And so all of these any derivative after the first derivative, those are called higher order derivatives.
cues.zh: 所以一階之後的任何導數，都叫高階導數。

cues.en: Now, the interpretations of these things and how to work with them, well, there's more things to learn about that that tends to be topic specific.
